title: Green Command Center — administration Home laboratory
mission: Prove the black-and-green command center design against the real /admin Home reading, in an isolated route. /admin is not replaced.

reference.note: HTML/CSS/SVG visual reference. Not an npm package. reference.png used for comparison only and never as a page background.

artifacts.what: the untouched reference prototype at the canonical viewport
the laboratory at the canonical viewport
reference with the laboratory composited at 50%
absolute per-pixel difference, rendered as heat (green = match, red = differ)
measured box of every structural element, reference vs laboratory
mean channel delta, visible-difference percentage, per-band breakdown

pixelComparison.divergenceCause: The reference declares height:116px on .metrics-row but its six cards compute to 145px and overflow it by 29px (overflow:visible), physically overlapping the hero panel below. The laboratory's cards fill the declared 116px instead. x, y and width are exact on all six.
pixelComparison.residualDeltaCause: Reference decorative curves that are not reproduced (they encode no data), plus real labels and figures differing from the prototype's invented text.
